Copper alloy nummus of Constantine I Date: 323-324 Diameter 15mm, weight 1.38g Obverse: beaded cuirassed bust facing right Obverse inscription: [CONSTANIVS] AVG Reverse: Alter inscribed VOT/IS/XX globe on top with three stars above, much of the left side is missing. Reverse inscription: [TRAN]QVILLIT[AS] Mint: Uncertain Condition: poor
